name: The Americana at Brand
summary: Posh mall offers high-end retailers, eateries, a theater & electric trolley, plus a landscaped park.
description: The Americana at Brand is a premier open-air lifestyle destination in Glendale that seamlessly blends luxury shopping, upscale dining, AMC movie theaters, and year-round entertainment experiences. Featuring a unique Caruso Signature membership program, family-friendly amenities, and seasonal festivities including Winterland celebrations, this property offers an elevated retail experience with Parisian-inspired touches and distinctive architectural charm. Conveniently located near Downtown Los Angeles and Hollywood, it serves as a sophisticated gathering place for both locals and visitors seeking an exceptional lifestyle center experience.
demographics: The Americana at Brand attracts affluent, style-conscious shoppers primarily from Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and surrounding San Gabriel Valley communities, with demographics skewing toward middle to upper-income households (median household incomes of $75,000-$150,000+) and age groups ranging from young professionals to established families. The trade area captures a diverse, cosmopolitan population with strong Armenian-American representation alongside a mix of Asian, Hispanic, and Caucasian residents who value premium shopping experiences and entertainment. Visitors exhibit sophisticated shopping patterns, favoring experiential retail, upscale dining, and entertainment options, with high brand loyalty and willingness to spend on quality goods and services in a refined, pedestrian-friendly environment.
